description: This file contains the implementation of the RoleStore class, which manages roles and role claims within the OrchardCore framework, including CRUD operations, claim management, and role retrieval.

classes.name: RoleStore
classes.description: Implements role and claim management for OrchardCore, supporting role creation, deletion, updates, and claim handling.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new role and triggers role created events.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a role if it is not a system role and triggers role removed events.

methods.name: FindByIdAsync
methods.description: Finds a role by its identifier.

methods.name: FindByNameAsync
methods.description: Finds a role by its normalized name.

methods.name: GetNormalizedRoleNameAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the normalized name of a role.

methods.name: GetRoleIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the role's ID, which is the upper-invariant version of the role name.

methods.name: SetNormalizedRoleNameAsync
methods.description: Sets the normalized name for a role.

methods.name: SetRoleNameAsync
methods.description: Sets the name for a role.

methods.name: AddClaimAsync
methods.description: Adds a claim to a role.

methods.name: GetClaimsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves claims associated with a role.

methods.name: RemoveClaimAsync
methods.description: Removes a claim from a role.
